meta.excluded_note: Withdrawn and desk-rejected papers are excluded from all statistics.
meta.corpus_note: ICLR publishes every submission, so counts measure what the field submits.

caveats.Label quality: Measured on 60 ICLR papers whose titles name a concept unambiguously: 100% of those concepts were recovered. 12% of all predicted labels had no matching phrase in the paper text - some are legitimate synonyms, some are wrong. Treat per-concept counts as accurate to a few percent, not exact.
caveats.The broad bucket: “Benchmarks & evaluation (broad)” is the largest concept and the least precise. It catches papers that release a benchmark AND papers that merely evaluate something, so it overstates benchmark releases. Read it as “does evaluation work”, not “ships a benchmark”. The revised taxonomy in topics.json narrows this, and has not been applied to these labels.
caveats.Not shown: Acceptance rates for 2027: no decisions have been released. Withdrawal rates: withdrawals accumulate until decisions, so 2027's figure is not comparable with a finished year's.
